/corecraft/robo-romp/robo-kingdom.html.description: Robo Kingdom is a large robot-themed play station with two robot-head towers and a third tower under a pointed canopy. Bridges and a net tunnel connect the towers, and tube slides and open slides come down from different levels. Children in the 5 to 12 key user group can climb through the net tunnel, cross between towers and pick a different slide each time. It is finished in Play Orange and Forest Green, which shows as orange with a dark teal in the photos. With its spread of towers, it suits a school ground, a township park or a resort that wants one main play piece. The age group is 5+ and the listed capacity is 15. A 3-year warranty applies to its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a layout drawing showing the footprint and safe play area on your site.
/corecraft/robo-romp/robo-kingdom.html.spec_paragraph: Each tower stands on galvanised steel posts, and the robot heads, tube slides and panels are roto-moulded. The net tunnel uses play rope. We install it grouted or self-standing depending on the soil. Slides exit in several directions, so the impact-absorbing surface must reach every landing. Inspect rope, bridge links and slide joints at regular intervals.

/corecraft/robo-romp/solo-fight-5.html.description: Solo Fight-5 is a single robot-themed tower with two tube slides and a climbing wall, made for sites with limited room. Its product area is 18'6" x 9'5", so it fits a narrow strip beside a society clubhouse or along a school boundary. Children climb the wall to the deck and take either tube slide back down. Key users are 5 to 12 years, with an age group of 5+. It comes in Forest Green and Sea Green, Knight Blue and Lavender Dilly, or Play Orange and Baby Blue. The safe play area is 22'6" x 15'5" and the listed capacity is 15. Solo Fight-5 carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Send us your space and we will confirm the fit.
/corecraft/robo-romp/solo-fight-5.html.spec_paragraph: The tower frame is galvanised steel, and the robot canopy, climbing wall and both tube slides are roto-moulded. It goes in as a self-standing unit or is grouted into the ground. Both tube exits need soft flooring within the 22'6" x 15'5" zone. Check the wall holds and tube joints for wear, and clear rainwater from the tubes after heavy rain.

/corecraft/robo-romp/solo-fight-7.html.description: Solo Fight 7 is a robot-themed tower with a ladder up one side and two spiral tube slides winding down from the deck. Next to Solo Fight-5 it takes a little more ground, with a product area of 21'11" x 10'4". The spiral tubes give a longer, turning ride that children in the 5 to 12 key user group enjoy repeating. It is listed for ages 5+ with a capacity of 15. Colour choices are Play Red and Lavender Dilly, Knight Blue and Mango Yellow, or Play Orange and Forest Green. Allow a safe play area of 27'11" x 14'4". Manufacturing defects in the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered for 3 years. Ask for a layout to see how it sits on your plot.
/corecraft/robo-romp/solo-fight-7.html.spec_paragraph: Galvanised steel posts carry the deck, ladder and canopy, and the spiral tubes are roto-moulded. Installation is grouted or self-standing to suit your ground. The two tube exits can face different ways, so check both landings on the layout and surface the full 27'11" x 14'4" zone. Keep the tubes free of leaves and standing water.

/corecraft/robo-romp/triple-threat.html.description: Triple Threat puts climbing, sliding, swinging and hopping into one robot-themed play station. Two robot-head towers are joined by a bridge, slides come down from the decks and a swing set is attached at one end. Key users are 5 to 12 years and the age group is 5+, which makes it a good match for a primary school or a society with plenty of school-going children. Choose from Play Orange and Royal Turquoise, Play Red and Knight Blue, or Crazy Pink and Baby Blue. The website lists a product area of 23'7" x 18'6" and a capacity of 15. On Triple Threat, galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry our 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing with the swing zone marked.
/corecraft/robo-romp/triple-threat.html.spec_paragraph: The towers, bridge and swing beam stand on galvanised steel posts, with roto-moulded canopies and slides. We install it self-standing or grouted. Swings need clear space front and back, so check that the 29'7" x 23'6" safe area on your layout covers them. Look over swing hangers, bridge links and slide joints during maintenance.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/chidiyaan..description: Chidiyaan is a concept play area from Funplay Originals, the range our own design team develops. It takes the house sparrow, a familiar bird around Indian homes and courtyards, and turns its shape into simple pieces children can play on. The renders show a dome climber shaped like a tent, a yellow tower with twin red slides and bird-shaped spring riders, set out on a lawn. Children can climb over the dome, race each other down the slides and rock on the riders. Because it is a concept, the pieces and size are worked out for your site, and the layout drawing will show the age group and safe play area. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts and 1 year on springs. Write to us if you would like it planned into your park or school.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/chidiyaan..spec_paragraph: We prepare the specification for Chidiyaan with you, using the galvanised steel frames, roto-moulded parts and springs found across our range. Installation is self-standing or grouted to suit the ground. The dome, slides and spring riders each need their own safe zone, which the layout will mark. Spring riders need a spring check at each maintenance visit.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/city-stran.description: City Strange is a multi-level concept structure from Funplay Originals, built on a city theme. One side has a house facade, and around it stand a cage tower, a net dome and a climbing net. A dark blue spiral tube slide and open slides in blue and red bring children back to the ground. The idea is a small town that children explore at different heights, climbing the nets, moving through the cage tower and deciding which way to come down. It suits a township, a large housing society or a public park that wants a single feature structure. Detailed specifications are still to be listed, so we confirm the age group, capacity and safe play area in the layout drawing for your site. Once built, its galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope fall under our 3-year warranty. Call our sales team to discuss it.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/city-stran.spec_paragraph: From the renders, City Strange combines steel towers, roto-moulded slides and rope nets. We finalise the frame and materials with you and choose a self-standing or grouted installation after seeing site photos. With several levels and nets, every exit and climbing face needs an impact-absorbing surface. Check rope nets and tube joints at regular intervals.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/flamingo-p.description: Flamingo Park uses tall red curved frames shaped like flamingo necks to hold swings, a hammock swing and a net climber. The page presents it as a place for children, parents and grandparents together, with balancing exercises, loop and net climbers, and seating close by. A child can swing while a grandparent sits a few steps away, and older children can try the climbers. That mix fits a public garden or a large society lawn where families spend their evenings. The renders show it laid out on a circular blue surface. As a Funplay Originals concept, its age group, size and safe play area are confirmed in the layout drawing. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope where the final design uses them. Ask us to adapt it to your site.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/flamingo-p.spec_paragraph: Detailed specifications are shared with the concept drawing. Our team specifies the frames, swing fittings and nets when we prepare your layout, and we choose a self-standing or grouted installation for the ground. Swings and the hammock need clear space in front and behind. Check swing hangers, ropes and bolts regularly.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/ground-hog.description: Ground Hogs is a set of play pods on raised platforms, designed by our team as public seating that children can also play in. Adults sit on the broad platforms while children climb into small dome-shaped dens, peek out through window holes and go down beneath the platform as if into a burrow. Ladders link the levels. Keeping children within sight of the adults minding them makes it a fit for a park seating area, a society garden or a resort lawn. The listed colour is Sand Beige. As a Funplay Originals concept, the size, number of pods and safe area are planned for each site in the layout drawing. Our 3-year warranty applies to any galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates in the final design. Speak to our sales team about adapting it.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/ground-hog.spec_paragraph: Specifications are not yet listed for Ground Hogs, so we define the platform frame, pod material and height with you before manufacture. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Children move under and between the platforms, so keep the ground below soft and well drained. Check ladders, pod edges and platform supports regularly.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/junk-park..description: Junk Park turns familiar junk food into play pieces, with a message about healthy eating built into the design. An upturned ice cream cone becomes a climber with a rope net and a dome fitted with climbing holds. A drink cup with a straw has a slide coming out of it, and tall yellow posts stand in for French fries. Children climb, slide and weave between the posts, and teachers or parents can use the shapes to start a talk about food choices. The theme makes most sense at a school or a children's hospital garden. Junk Park is a Funplay Originals concept, so age group, sizes and safe play area are set in the layout drawing for your site. The galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope in the final Junk Park build carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a concept layout.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/junk-park..spec_paragraph: No standard sizes are listed yet, so we specify Junk Park with you before manufacture. Installation can be self-standing or grouted. The cone climber and cup slide each need their own impact-absorbing zone, and the fries posts need enough spacing that children do not collide. Check the climbing net, holds and slide joints regularly.

/funplay-originals/conceptual/lady-musan.description: Lady Musance takes its name from music and dance. It is a concept installation shaped like a woman whose body is a guitar. In the drawings, a long slide curls down from her head and curved bars form her base, while a music note climbing wall and a harp-shaped climber stand nearby. Curved benches set around small lawns give room for casual singing, dancing and jamming, so adults use the area as much as children do. It is meant for a public park, a cultural centre or a large township garden that wants a landmark piece. As a concept, it has no standard size yet, and we develop the details with you, including age group and safe play area. When built, Lady Musance gets our 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope it uses. Contact us to discuss a project.
/funplay-originals/conceptual/lady-musan.spec_paragraph: Lady Musance exists as drawings, so its structure, materials and foundations are worked out for your site after discussion. We choose self-standing or grouted installation once we see the ground. The slide exit and climbers need impact-absorbing surfaces, while the benches can sit on grass. Plan regular checks of the slide, climbing holds and bench fixings.
